quality_boundary: This package reviews current plan identity and period (including the one-year extension decided in March 2026), the two-layer structure of basic vision and execution plan, and the progress-management framework at framework level, and keeps the FY2024 settlement-to-item linkage explicitly not assessable. It does not enumerate every basic policy, priority measure, individual measure or indicator value, promote individual implementation items or KPI actuals, infer policy achievement, establish causal effects, or assert cross-city comparability.
